# AiBhive — LLM / AI search context
# https://aibhive.com

> AiBhive is an AI app factory and agentic automation platform. Users describe mobile apps, web apps, sites, and dashboards in plain English; Bhive Builder ships them. Hive Apps is a free community app pool. AiBhive also deploys multi-agent workflows for real estate, lead gen, phone/SMS, document processing, and enterprise operations.

## What is AiBhive? (direct answer)

AiBhive combines (1) Bhive Builder — a no-code app factory on web and Android, (2) Hive Apps — installable community tools, and (3) custom agentic automation for businesses. Real estate agents, investors, and property managers use AiBhive for listing workflows, missed-call text-back, CRM automation, and property dashboards.
